messages:
Kenji Watanabe: Quick note for tomorrow's orientation: some folks can't get into the Zoom waiting room unless they sign in with SSO. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya Singh: Yes! Contractors ran into that last week. We usually publish a backup join link in the event description that doesn't require SSO.
Marco Alvarez: Can we also add a short "virtual lobby" instruction in the calendar so people know to wait there until the host admits them? A lot of new hires join and think they're late.
onboarding-bot: onboarding-bot added note to event: 'If SSO blocks you, use backup link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/8882223333 (passcode: 1122). Host will admit from virtual lobby. Recording will be uploaded to onboarding drive.'
Kenji Watanabe: Perfect. Two more things: 1) where will the recording live (drive folder link?), and 2) can contractors get the recording or is it internal-only?
Priya Singh: Recording will be uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/2026-orientation (internal access). Contractors get a 30-day link; internal hires get 180 days. If a contractor needs access after 30 days they can request it via legal-onboarding@redwood.com.
Zoe Kim: Could someone add the explicit UTC time in the description? I have new hires in SGP and NZ and the calendar conversions confused them.
Marco Alvarez: Added line: 'Start: 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST / 03:00 NZST next day)'. Also noted DST caveats for AZ.
Kenji Watanabe: Awesome, thanks. TL;DR for new hires: use backup link if SSO blocks, wait in virtual lobby, recording in onboarding drive (internal 180d / contractors 30d), UTC time shown. Welcome aboard! :tada:
